scope: Read-only review of all 31 native J references on both current boards, plus user indicators, optical/acoustic interfaces, battery holder and controls. This is a hash-bound finding snapshot, not a production release or an applied placement correction.

provenance.method: pcbnew.LoadBoard of both actual native PCB files; local footprint geometry; selected primary manufacturer drawings. Native source-contract edits in progress are not credited until regeneration and reinspection.

coordinates.native_front: F.Cu is exterior; B.Cu is interboard interior
coordinates.native_B_transform: Reflect footprint-local Y, then rotate by negative native rotation_deg, then add native anchor.
coordinates.assembled_rear_transform: For comparison in the front assembly frame, rear native x maps to 80-x and y remains y.
coordinates.planar_direction_convention: +Y is bottom edge, -Y antenna edge, -X left native edge, +X right native edge. Front-normal/rear-normal axes are stated separately.

gct_usb.section: Sheet 1, Recommended PCB Layout: As viewed from component side; PCB Edge and mating views
gct_usb.review: Fresh official PDF downloaded and visually inspected 2026-09-07. Local signal tails y=-3.68, mating edge y=+3.675.

jae_usb.section: Exact product drawing linked by standard KiCad footprint
jae_usb.review: Manufacturer page fetch timed out in this review. Actual standard/native footprint inspected: signal tails y=-3.05 and shell front y=+3.6; fresh manufacturer mouth-offset confirmation remains open.

grove.review: Fresh official OPL PDF visually inspected. Socket opening is opposite four rear signal tails; custom footprint tails local y=-3.815, mouth toward +Y. Drawing does not explicitly prescribe board-edge offset.

microsd.section: EDC-325165-00-00, sheet 1/6, mounting-side layout and card travel
microsd.review: Existing official PDF page visually inspected against current standard footprint. Contacts at local y=-7.725; mouth toward +Y, shell mouth datum +8.125. Card lock/eject/over-stroke clearances are separate from body courtyard.

fx8p.section: FX8C-xxP-SV1(92), EDC3-151087-22 sheet 1, mounting-side land pattern and polarization
fx8p.review: Exact primary drawing visually inspected. Local pad1 [-11.7,+2.7]; polarization/large locator at left,+Y.

fx8s.section: FX8C-xxS-SV5(92), EDC3-151023-22 sheet 1, mounting-side land pattern and polarization
fx8s.review: Exact primary drawing visually inspected. Local pad1 [-11.7,-2.85]; polarization/large locator at left,-Y. Unequal solder-tail row offsets must not be mistaken for a body-centre displacement.

hle.section: Revision AI, sheet 1, FIG1 pass-through and section A-A; note10
hle.review: Fresh official PDF visually inspected. Actual mating is vertical; formed through-hole tails do not make it a right-angle mating socket. The standard KiCad footprint suffix Horizontal is not evidence of an interface-direction defect. -LC requires manual placement per manufacturer note10.

ir_emitter.section: Rev1.6, page5, Package Dimensions and Recommended Solder Pad
ir_emitter.review: Fresh official PDF visually inspected. Lens points to local -Y for the drawn horizontal pad pair. Recommended lands are 0.90x1.40 mm with 1.80-mm inner gap (2.70-mm centre pitch, 3.60-mm overall span).

ir_carrier.section: Page4 package dimensions and proposed component-side pad layout
ir_carrier.review: Existing official PDF visually inspected. Lens projects toward +Y from the pin row in the component-side plan. Body/lens offset from the pad row must be preserved; rotation alone is not complete optical-port registration.

ir_demod.review: Primary family source identified and local PDF checked. Current footprint shares Heimdall pad geometry. Final TR feeder presentation and optical body datum require explicit comparison; no new MPN is selected.

power_switch.section: VL01/14/26 ordering table and page5 JS102011SCQN
power_switch.review: Primary text retrieved; local PDF download blocked403. Ordering table calls SC Vertical, Gullwing while current device kind says right-angle. Exact actuator axis is not accepted from text alone.

findings.finding: All four USB connectors are B.Cu/0. Their local +Y mating direction becomes native -Y, toward the PCB interior rather than bottom edge. The three GCT mouths are at y142.360 instead of150. JAE native front is approximately y142.835; its fresh manufacturer datum is still pending.
findings.remediation: Rotate to B180 and place from manufacturer mouth/PCB-edge datum, then reroute/check real native pads, shell supports, local collisions and assembled plug access. Do not preserve copper solely to preserve old geometry.

findings.finding: Local +Y socket entrance maps to -Y on B0. Existing bottom-facing mockup is not the native geometry.
findings.remediation: B180 gives required +Y direction. Freeze exact board-edge/mating datum and cable envelope before setting anchor; no manufacturer edge offset is guessed.

findings.finding: DM3AT local +Y mouth maps to native -X at B90, facing left into the lower board instead of bottom.
findings.remediation: B180 gives +Y. Conditional flush-mouth anchor y141.875 follows local mouth +8.125 and board edge150; verify seating/push/ejection travel, copper keepouts and collisions before acceptance.

findings.finding: After physical rear x reflection, current body centres differ by5.0 mm in X and0.25 mm inY. Matching local B0/B0 orientations reverse the longitudinal contact/polarization order in assembled view; simple centre translation is insufficient.
findings.remediation: Geometrically coherent candidate: retain UIJ18 B0 [42.5,122.25], set RFJ12 B180 [37.5,122.25]. This aligns body axes and contact end/polarization under rear mirror. Recheck all80 logical mates and actual body/height/locator geometry; solder-tail row centres differ by0.15 mm by manufacturer design, not a reason to offset body centres.

findings.finding: Selected SJ-43504-SMT-TR is a mid-mount socket; current native RF board has only outer Edge.Cuts and its custom footprint contributes no cutout. A rectangular proxy body does not satisfy the manufacturer installation.
findings.remediation: Mechanical-review owner must register exact cutout/mouth to native pose and verify plug approach before accepting placement. Direction and exact slot polygon remain that review's authority.

findings.finding: Parallel mechanical review identified manufacturer1048P locator features absent from native footprint; exterior F.Cu mounting alone is not complete installation evidence.
findings.remediation: Use the dedicated mechanical finding and exact1048P drawing to register locator holes; do not infer a new hole pattern here.

findings.finding: All10 user status/TX LEDs are native B.Cu, several underneath the display/interior circuitry. No light-pipe design exists to transfer these indicators to the user-facing exterior.
findings.remediation: Place exact10 indicators F.Cu at current approved exterior indicator datums, then inspect labels and obstruction. Parallel controls reviewer owns correction.

findings.finding: Current B0 VSMY14940 points along native +Y instead of out the left edge. Custom footprint claims recommended lands but uses1.2x1.0 atx+/-0.9, whereas primary page5 specifies0.9x1.4 with2.7 centre pitch.
findings.remediation: Correct recommended land geometry and polarity/body/lens datum first; B270 directs the demonstrated local -Y lens axis toward native -X. Reposition from lens/edge datum and keep optical tunnel clear; do not accept old copper or symmetric proxy body.

findings.finding: For the primary-derived local +Y Heimdall optical direction, U24 B0 points native -Y parallel to left edge; U23 B90 points outward -X. The custom footprint centres its body on the pin row, so optical offset and TR/TT assembly presentation are not fully captured by a rotation-only check.
findings.remediation: Verify exact physical body/pad/lens datum for each accepted MPN; U24 needs outward orientation, nominallyB90. Retain U23 outward direction only after datum/edge clearance inspection. No component substitution authorized.

findings.finding: RUN/KILL switch B0 near native left edge cannot be declared externally accessible from its rectangular body. Source ordering calls SC vertical gullwing, current catalog kind calls it right-angle; exact lever direction is not yet visually reconciled.
findings.remediation: Inspect exact page5/3D actuator against custom pad geometry, then choose pose or register a real access aperture. No guessed90/180-degree repair or replacement MPN.

findings.finding: MK1 is a top-port microphone on B.Cu: its port opens into the interboard gap, not directly through the bottom PCB edge. LS1 is only a two-pad wire termination, not the24x12x4.5-mm speaker body. Native pad placement does not prove sound outlet, diaphragm clearance, strain relief or owner/factory attachment.
findings.remediation: Register separate microphone acoustic path and speaker body/grille/wire route to assembled geometry; explicitly retain owner-assembly scope. No guarantee of acoustic performance from connectivity.

findings.finding: IndividualPCB courtyards and inward-facing service headers do not prove access in an11-mm sandwich or clearance from opposing components/fasteners. USB/Grove/card plug and finger envelopes must use corrected assembled transforms.
findings.remediation: After source corrections regenerate native poses and evaluate opposing bodies, connector plug sweeps, cable landing/inspection cylinders and user access. Do not use this matrix as a full3D clearance pass.

limitations: No production files, MPN selections, native copper or placement contracts were changed by this review.
All31 J references are inventoried, but complete metrology and manufacturer3D comparison is not claimed for every part.
Buttons and LED placement are being independently corrected by the controls reviewer; their observed old native snapshot is retained here without claiming the repairs are applied.
Display FPC slot and fold, headphone cutout and holder locators are owned by the mechanical review; consult its current findings before acceptance.
Ten SMA axes are outward in this snapshot; PCB finished-thickness fit remains the separately open H6-SMA-FINISHED-THICKNESS-FIT gate.
U.FL mating is normal to B.Cu, not an outward edge entrance. Existing native-axis/cable-reach contract is useful but does not prove opposing-body clearance or received-cable strain.
No order/factory readiness, fresh DRC pass, electrical functionality or full interface gate closure follows from this read-only artifact.
